headline: Three Fronts Record Further Base Changes
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledgers show further shifts in Nevish Line, Linn’s Mercy and Weathered Expanse. Nevish Line now holds six Colonial bases, two Warden and none neutral, compared with four, three and one previously; its 24-hour tally is 47 event rows, though none were logged in the latest two hours. Linn’s Mercy stands at ten Colonial, no Warden and one neutral, up from seven, two and two; five event rows arrived in the latest two hours, with the latest recorded at 05:55 UTC. Weathered Expanse remains unsettled at five Warden, one Colonial and three neutral, versus three apiece and three neutral in the prior return; three rows came in the last two hours and 12 in six. Stonecradle remains eight Colonial to one Warden, while its 14 daily event rows have gone quiet in the latest six hours. Mooring County is still wholly Warden-held, with eight daily rows but none in six hours. Callahan’s Passage reports heavy recent casualties on both sides, yet no base events. The war remains unresolved; 34 victory towns are required.
